_about: Example chunk-metadata sidecar for the context index. Maps a chunk id (manifest id, equal to the chunk topic) to hand-authored retrieval metadata the ContextIndexGenerator merges over the auto-derived metadata. This is a scrubbed reference using ExampleVessel; the real, operator-local sidecar names real repositories and lives at contextRetrieval.chunkMetadataPath, a stable path outside the git checkout. Metadata ABOUT the memory and docs, never their content.
